data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Pacific Ridge's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in PKBK and ALCO.

PKBK disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing on September 24, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1315399/000143774926031135/pkbk20260923_8k.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
